description: This PHP script generates and renders baseline reporting for test plans within the TestLink project. It interacts with the database to retrieve test plan and test suite data, constructs statistical summaries, and outputs the results either as a report page or as a downloadable spreadsheet. It includes functions for initializing the GUI, building email configurations, and generating Excel reports, utilizing third-party libraries such as PhpSpreadsheet.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class managing test plan data, used to instantiate and retrieve test plan details.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class providing static methods to interact with test project data.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Class extending Smarty template engine for rendering the report page.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Constructs an email configuration object with subject line generated from test plan details.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object with test plan, platform, and other metadata for report generation.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an Excel spreadsheet report of test plan results using PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: xlsStepOne
methods.description: Creates the initial header content for the Excel report.

methods.name: initLblSpreadsheet
methods.description: Initializes label mappings used for spreadsheet headers.

methods.name: initStyleSpreadsheet
methods.description: Defines styles used for formatting the Excel spreadsheet.

methods.name: setCellRangeSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates array of cell range identifiers (column labels) for spreadsheet columns.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the user has access rights to the specified test plan or project.
